benchmark_data: benchmark the data loading pipeline performance by measuring images per second and warmup time
run_benchmark_data_train: run benchmark_data with the train split to measure training data loader throughput
run_benchmark_data_val: run benchmark_data with the val split to measure validation data loader throughput
run_benchmark_cli: run the benchmark_data CLI module via main() with hydra config overrides from command line
run_hydra_main: run hydra_main with a list of hydra config override strings to benchmark data loading
